g.text: Direct read/write (AutorController/CategoriaController have no service layer of their own)
Invalidates the token on logout (blacklist); email verification code
Reads/writes loans, reservations and fines (JPA + SQL procedures)
Reads the user and QR token (Postgres-generated column)
Reads/writes chat sessions and messages; queries the knowledge base
Asks the model for the answer, with grounding prompt
Queries real book availability (grounding, keeps the model from inventing it)
Reads/writes users, roles, system configuration and audit log
Checks the token against the blacklist
Loads user, roles and account status
Counts messages per user in the current window
